title: EventEnvelope
description: Every message on every DevAssist Kafka topic is wrapped in this envelope. The payload shape is determined by `type`; see payloads/<type>.schema.json.

event_id.description: Unique id for this event. Consumers use it for idempotency (processed_events table).

type.description: Event type. Equal to the Kafka topic the event is published on.

version.description: Payload schema version. Bump on breaking payload changes.

timestamp.description: When the event was produced (RFC 3339, UTC).

source.description: Name of the producing service, e.g. api, orchestrator, indexer, sandbox-runner.

trace_id.description: Correlation id carried through every service and log line. For job events this is the job id; for repo events the repository id.
